title: A state is conscious when a suitable higher-order thought accompanies it

statements.text: A mental state is conscious, nonintrospectively, just in case one has a roughly contemporaneous higher-order thought to the effect that one is in that very state. The explanation is that the mental state causes that higher-order thought to occur.

sources.quote: a mental state is conscious - nonintrospectively conscious - just in case one has a roughly contemporaneous thought to the effect that one is in that very mental state

Since a mental state is conscious if it is accompanied by a suitable higher-order thought, we can explain a mental state's being conscious by hypothesizing that the mental state itself causes that higher-order thought to occur.
